identity.description: Smartsheet, the collaborative work management platform (spreadsheet-style work management, sheets, workspaces, automation). Confirmed via the vendor's own GitHub org description and developer docs.
identity.identity_notes: The vendor GitHub org describes its SDKs as 'for the Smartsheet collaborative work management platform', matching the requested product. Developer docs live on developers.smartsheet.com; the marketing site is smartsheet.com.

auth.oauth_flows: 3-legged authorization code flow. Apps register in Developer Tools to get a client ID and secret, exchange an authorization code at the token endpoint, and refresh via POST /token with a refresh token.
auth.token_refresh: Access tokens expire after 604799 seconds (about 7 days). Refresh by calling POST /token with the refresh token, which returns a new access and refresh token pair.
auth.scopes_notes: Apps must request at least one access scope and should request only what they need. Personal access tokens generated in the UI carry the owning user's permissions.

access.production_restrictions: OAuth app registration needs Smartsheet to accept a developer request and activate Developer Tools for the account; a denied request is referred to a Customer Success Manager. No public app review requirement was found in the pages checked.

api.limitations: The getting-started guide makes no rate-limit statement. Breadth across the core product was not established because the full resource index was not fetched. Webhook details come from search summaries, not from a fetched page. A separate Resource Management API uses its own auth (auth query parameter or header).
